connectionError: Could not connect to the server

loginPage.title: Your treatment history, whole.
loginPage.description: Labs, medications, imaging, and notes on how you feel. All together, so you can see changes and remember what matters.

offlinePage.tagline: Can't reach the server. Check your internet or VPN and open the app again.

setupPage.taglineServer: Treatment history on your own server.

loginForm.noPasskeys: No passkeys added yet. Sign in with your password and add one in Settings → “Sign-in and security”
loginForm.cancelledRetry: Confirmation canceled. Select “Confirm with passkey” again.
loginForm.expired: Time ran out. Enter your password again
loginForm.setInEnv: The password is set by the server administrator in .env. Only they can reset it.
loginForm.changed: Password changed. The old code no longer works. Here is the new one.
loginForm.recoverIntro: Enter the recovery code MedControl showed at first launch or at the last password reset, then set a new password. Other devices will ask you to sign in again.
loginForm.passkeyPrompt: Password correct. Now confirm sign-in with a passkey: Face ID, Touch ID, or your phone passcode.

faceLock.unavailable: Face ID is not available on this iPad. Sign in with the password.
faceLock.failed: Face ID didn't recognise you. Try again, or sign in with the password.

setupForm.noServer: Can't reach the server. Check that the containers are running: docker compose ps
setupForm.intro: First launch. Set a password and language. The next steps fill MedControl in right away.
setupForm.codeHint: This site is reachable from more than this computer, so the wizard asks for a code. That way, whoever opens the page first can't take over the installation. The code is in the server log. Run this in the MedControl folder: docker compose logs gateway | grep SETUP_CODE (or open setup-code.txt in the data folder).
setupForm.regionHint: Format for dates, times, and numbers. You can change it in Settings.
